_doc: Symbiote genome (M3, design bible section 6: 'a working genetics system; spend Symbiotic Essence to research the genome'). Four strands of three genes. Sequencing a gene spends Essence at End Cycle (needs the Gene Splicing tech) and needs the gene before it in the strand. A gene can unlock a symbiote strain, add a bonus for every fused unit (symbiote), or carry ordinary effects in the shared vocabulary (effects). Strains are fused into a unit standing in one of your settlements, one per unit, for their Essence cost: a large UPow bonus plus traits. hardened = ignores the kaiju penalty, so a fused conventional unit can fight Abyssians. feeder = kills drop half again as much Essence. influence = Influence per cycle while the unit lives. Icons: assets/art/icon_symbiote_<id>.png (64x64).

genes.name: Chitin Weave
genes.blurb: Abyssian shell protein, spun into armour that grows.

genes.name: Bone Lattice
genes.blurb: A skeleton under the skeleton. Every symbiote hits a little harder.

genes.name: Abyssal Plating
genes.blurb: The hide of a Deep King, reverse-engineered.

genes.name: Hunter Glands
genes.blurb: Adrenal sacs that never run dry.

genes.name: Blood Sense
genes.blurb: Fused units smell a battle three hexes off.

genes.name: Apex Instinct
genes.blurb: The thing at the top of the food chain, now at the top of yours.

genes.name: Gill Sacs
genes.blurb: Wet tissue that knits wounds shut.

genes.name: Pressure Organs
genes.blurb: Organs built for the trench push fused units forward like a current.

genes.name: Deep Communion
genes.blurb: You hear the rifts breathing now. Some of what they exhale is yours.

genes.name: Hive Echo
genes.blurb: Every symbiote feels every other's wounds, and closes them.

genes.name: Chorus Seed
genes.blurb: A thought that grows in other minds until they agree with you.

strains.name: Chitin Mantle
strains.blurb: A living shell. Kaiju claws skid off it.

strains.name: Razor Brood
strains.blurb: A swarm of hooked larvae that lives under the armour and leaves it only to feed.

strains.name: Tidal Graft
strains.blurb: Regenerative tissue. Wounds close between cycles.

strains.name: Neural Lace
strains.blurb: A web of nerves across the hull. The unit thinks with two minds, and one of them is yours.

strains.name: Leviathan Hide
strains.blurb: The unit wears a kaiju. The kaiju does not seem to mind.

strains.name: Deep Choir
strains.blurb: The unit hums in the Abyss's key, and the sea carries it.

strains.name: Chorus Seed
strains.blurb: People near it start to agree with you, and cannot say why.
